name: Kanto
description: The original region, home to the first 151 Pokémon. Famous for Pallet Town and the powerful Pokémon League at Indigo Plateau.

name: Johto
description: A region steeped in tradition and mystery, connected to Kanto. Known for legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh and Lugia.

name: Hoenn
description: A tropical island-heavy region with diverse ecosystems. Home to the weather trio and deep sea mysteries.

name: Sinnoh
description: A mountainous northern region with rich mythology. Mount Coronet divides the land and hides ancient secrets.

name: Unova
description: A cosmopolitan region inspired by New York City, featuring entirely new Pokémon and a deep storyline.

name: Kalos
description: A beautiful region inspired by France, introducing Mega Evolution and the first fully 3D Pokémon experience.

name: Alola
description: A tropical island chain inspired by Hawaii, featuring regional variants and the Island Challenge instead of Gyms.

name: Galar
description: A region inspired by the United Kingdom, featuring the Gigantamax phenomenon and the Wild Area.

name: Paldea
description: A vast open-world region inspired by the Iberian Peninsula, introducing Terastallization and three story paths.
